YOUR PATHWAY TO SUCCESS

International Study Application Process

A transparent, step-by-step roadmap to guide you from your first consultation to your first day on campus.

1

Profile Evaluation & Eligibility Check

1-2 Days

Our experts analyze your academic background, test scores, and career goals to determine the best study destinations and programs for you.

Key Documents:

  • Academic Transcripts
  • CV/Resume
  • Language Test Scores (if available)
2

Course & University Shortlisting

3-5 Days

We help you select up to 4 universities that perfectly match your profile, budget, and future career aspirations.

Key Documents:

  • Career Goals Questionnaire
3

ALO Counselor 1-on-1 Review Session

1 Day

A detailed session to finalize your university choices and discuss the exact requirements for each application.

4

Document Verification & Translation

3-7 Days

We ensure all your documents are authenticated, translated if necessary, and formatted according to university standards.

Key Documents:

  • Passport
  • Recommendation Letters
  • Statement of Purpose (SOP)
5

University Application Submission

1-2 Weeks

Our team meticulously fills out and submits your applications to the chosen universities, ensuring zero errors.

Key Documents:

  • Application Forms
  • Application Fees (if applicable)
6

Offer Letter Processing

2-6 Weeks

We track your applications and assist in fulfilling any conditions to secure an Unconditional Offer Letter.

Key Documents:

  • Conditional/Unconditional Offer Letters
7

Deposit Payment & Visa Document Issuance

1-3 Weeks

Guidance on paying tuition deposits safely to receive vital visa documents like CAS (UK), COE (Australia), or I-20 (USA).

Key Documents:

  • Bank Statements
  • Financial Affidavits
8

Visa Application & Pre-Departure Briefing

3-8 Weeks

Comprehensive visa interview preparation, application submission, and a final briefing to get you ready for campus life.

Key Documents:

  • Visa Application Forms
  • Medical Certificates (if required)

Frequently Asked Questions

Everything you need to know about the application journey.

How long does the entire application process take?
The complete process from profile evaluation to visa approval typically takes 3 to 6 months, depending on the intake and country.
Do I need to pay an application fee for universities?
Some universities charge application fees, while others offer waivers. We prioritize universities offering fee waivers for our students whenever possible.
Is the ALO Education counseling service free?
Yes, our initial counseling and university shortlisting services are completely free of charge.
Can I apply without an IELTS score?
While IELTS is preferred, many universities accept alternatives like PTE, Duolingo, or offer English waivers based on your academic background (Medium of Instruction letter).
What happens if my visa gets rejected?
In the rare event of a visa rejection, our team will analyze the reasons and guide you through the re-application process or explore alternative destinations.
